implementation.behavior: When guest X11 is unavailable and guest-reported display matches the requested display, perform a bounded read-only Termux-visible ps query and add a blocker only if that display is not observed.
implementation.privacy: The process inventory query reads only PID/comm for visible processes, then retrieves argv only for matching termux-x11 PIDs (maximum 8); PID/argv are not returned or persisted.
implementation.blocker_schema: Existing blockers field only; kept within its declared maximum of four. No response schema/API version change.

full_suite.runtime: local PRoot Debian test runner; fixture/unit evidence, not native Android runtime qualification

display_0.new_blocker: requested display :0 not observed in the Termux-visible X11 process list

limits: Process-table visibility does not prove a server is absent; hidden or differently named processes are not ruled out.
A matching display process does not prove server connectivity or Ternux ownership.
The verifier checks control reachability; it does not play audio or establish audible output.
